name: Zenith Neo 5G
description: Zenith Neo 5G is an AI-powered smartphone built specifically for Indian college students and young professionals. Features include automatic AI audio lecture transcription and summaries, 5000 mAh battery with intelligent 2-day power management, 120Hz smooth AMOLED display, 64MP low-light campus camera, and an on-device privacy vault to keep personal notes and chats safe without cloud tracking.
target_group: Indian college students and young working professionals

features.name: AI Lecture Notes & Audio Summaries
features.explanation: Automatically records lectures, removes background classroom noise, and generates bullet summaries with key formulas.

features.name: Smart Campus Battery (5000 mAh)
features.explanation: Machine learning adapts to college schedule and travel, easily lasting through full days of classes and evening commutes.

features.name: 120Hz Fluid AMOLED Display
features.explanation: Vibrant, ultra-smooth screen perfect for reading PDFs, multitasking between apps, and watching reels.

features.name: Low-Light Night Portrait Camera
features.explanation: Captures crisp group photos and event memories even in dimly lit college auditoriums or cafes.

features.name: On-Device Privacy Vault
features.explanation: Keeps photos, bank details, and personal notes isolated on the device with hardware encryption and zero cloud tracking.

features.name: ZenOS Bloatware-Free Interface
features.explanation: Clean and fast stock-like Android experience with zero spam notifications and guaranteed 3-year OS updates.
